_comment: EXAMPLE FILE -- fictional candidate 'Jordan Doe'. This shows the shape of resume_template.json: a bank of tagged, id'd bullets that the tailoring drafter (jobhunt/tailor/drafter.py) may SELECT FROM but never invent beyond. That constraint -- select an existing id, never write new bullet text -- is the anti-fabrication guardrail, and it's enforced in code (see _validate_no_fabrication in drafter.py), not just requested in the prompt. Copy this to resume_template.json and replace every field with your own real, factual experience.
summary_variants: Platform engineer with 8+ years building integration and automation systems for regulated fintech products, now applying that same delivery discipline to AI-assisted engineering workflows.
Solutions-focused backend engineer specializing in payments infrastructure, API design, and compliance-aware system architecture.

bullets.text: Designed and operated a payments-reconciliation service processing 2M+ transactions/day, cutting manual reconciliation effort by 60%.
Led the migration of a monolithic billing system to event-driven microservices, reducing incident recovery time from hours to minutes.
Built REST APIs and internal tooling for a compliance-reporting platform used by 40+ internal analysts.
Introduced automated integration testing for the core transaction pipeline, reducing production defects by 35%.
